content_text:
🛠️ Build Log: Autonomous Personal Media Agency

Most AI posting tools maximize volume and spam corporate clichés. When building across systems, robotics, and embedded hardware, ungrounded AI content destroys credibility.

So I engineered an autonomous media agency guided by one Prime Directive: Credibility Over Frequency.

Architectural highlights:
• Zero Autonomous External Writes: Cannot dispatch without a valid HMAC-SHA256 authenticated approval token.
• Deterministic DRC: Domain Design Rule Checks enforce mains isolation, logic level shifting, and 100% claim grounding.
• Persistent Lifecycle: 9 strictly validated stages from IDEA to ANALYZED. Stage skipping is programmatically forbidden.
• Native NO-OP: The agency chooses to publish nothing when technical substance thresholds are not met.

📦 Open source v0.1.0 on GitHub (86/86 passing tests, MIT license).
🔗 GitHub repo bağlantısı ve dokümantasyon ilk yorumda ve profildeki linkte.
